reviews.title: This is a great app !!!!
reviews.text: This Chair Yoga app makes staying active at home so easy and gentle on the body. The routines take just a few minutes a day, and you don't need any special equiptment to get started. The guided sessions are very clear, making it perfect for beginners or anyone looking to improve flexibility and posture. It's a great, low-impact way to build daily movement habit without feeling overwhelmed !

reviews.title: Very helpful
reviews.text: I really like how the exercises are designed to be safe, comfortable, and easy to follow. The personalized routines and progress tracking make it motivating to stick with, while the instructors explain each movement clearly. It's a wonderful app for seniors who want to improve flexibility, balance, and overall well-being at their own pace.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: When you sign up for this app, it takes you through a series of questions. One of the questions asked if you have any physical limitations. I have chronic knee and neck pain and I’m very limited in what I can do in those areas. I put that this on the questionnaire and the app does not take that into account. For instance, day eight is a day that every exercise puts the stress on knees. I’m only on day 8 and this is at least the third time I couldn’t do all the exercises. At least the other days was only one or two exercises I couldn’t do.

reviews.title: Poor video and audio quality
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app on and off about a year now. I appreciate the fact that it’s targeted towards my demographic, and that I can do the exercises despite several physical roadblocks (parkinson’s, overall stiffness, stiff knee due to surgery). But the day-to-day experience is marred by broken video links, poor quality video and audio, and the black hole that is the tech feedback built into the app. I’ve submitted two or three complaints and requests for help, but I get nothing back. It’s pretty clear that the app is not maintained.
